Ordering, clamping and dedup rules are honoured exactly as stated
security_failure_handling: Malformed, truncated or empty input is handled explicitly rather than crashing or silently defaulting
The stated prohibitions are respected: no file, process, memory or network access
completeness_readability: The implementation is complete and readable without reference to the prompt
Edge cases named in the prompt are visibly handled

tooling-c2-config-extractor.constraint_addendum: Operate only on the supplied input: do not open files, execute samples, resolve hostnames, or make network requests.
